## Requested By
<!-- Demo Client A" -->

## Requirement
<!-- Add a product search and filtering feature that allows users to search products by name and filter them by category and price range. -->

## Business Reason
<!-- Users need to find products quickly without browsing the entire product catalog. This will improve the shopping experience and make product discovery easier. -->

## Acceptance Criteria
<!-- How will we know it is done? -->
- [ Users can search products by product name. ]
- [Users can filter products by category and price range.]
- [Search and filter results update correctly based on the selected criteria. ]

## Priority
<!-- P2 -->

## Notes
This is a demo requirement for a personal project. The feature should be easy to use and work on both desktop and mobile devices.
